column3: The Hebrew reads “officials of Jezreel”; NASB keeps it. NASB supplies “of the children.”
“The good and the right” is rendered “the best and fittest.”
“If you are mine” is rendered “If you are on my side,” and “bringing up” as “rearing.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “for.”
NASB joins the end of the verse to verse 13.
“Brothers” is rendered “relatives,” and “for the peace of” as “to greet.”
“Blessed” is rendered “greeted”; the Hebrew “there is, and there is” is split into Jehonadab’s answer and Jehu’s reply. NASB spells the name “Jehonadab.”
The Hebrew plural “they made him ride” is rendered singular, “he made him ride.”
“Those who serve” is rendered “worshipers,” and “guile” as “cunning.”
“Mouth to mouth” is rendered “from one end to the other.”
“His life in place of his life” is rendered “shall give up his life in exchange.”
“Runners” is rendered “guard,” and “the city of the house of Baal” as “the inner room of the house of Baal”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Outhouses” is rendered “a latrine,” and “pulled down” as “broke down.”
“Descendants of the fourth” is rendered “your sons of the fourth generation.”
